title: Fake Hardcore UI Hearts
description: Makes Minecraft feel like Hardcore mode with custom visuals and effects.
body:
Bring the Hardcore experience visuals into normal Minecraft survival mode!

This lightweight resource pack replaces the default hearts with Hardcore-style hearts while keeping your world in normal survival mode.

Perfect for:
- Hardcore-themed worlds
- Survival challenges
- PvP texture setups
- Players who love the Hardcore UI style

Features:
- Hardcore heart textures
- Clean vanilla-style look
- Very lightweight
- Easy to install
- Works on Minecraft 1.21.1

The Fake Hardcore UI Hearts Team
